subject.title: [Feature]: Add native slash-command menu to Feishu bot

question: Should the bundled Feishu channel provide and maintain a native bot command menu as a supported parity feature with other channel-native command surfaces?
rationale: The request introduces a new user-facing channel capability and its desired scope, lifecycle, and support commitment cannot be inferred safely from the issue alone.

options.title: Sponsor focused Feishu parity
options.body: Approve a plugin-owned implementation after direct verification of Feishu’s bot-menu API, permissions, limits, update lifecycle, and command authorization behavior.

options.title: Keep plain-text commands only
options.body: Decline native-menu support and retain the documented plain-text command workflow if the platform contract or maintenance cost is unsuitable.

options.title: Request an API/design spike
options.body: Ask for a narrow proof-of-concept and platform-contract evidence before committing to a permanent supported menu surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused Feishu parity
recommendation.body: Approve a plugin-owned implementation after direct verification of Feishu’s bot-menu API, permissions, limits, update lifecycle, and command authorization behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete participant identified in the supplied context and have offered to implement the proposal; source-history ownership needs a follow-up inspection.
